headword: {財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}
gloss: fiscal policy; government spending and taxation policy

definitions.gloss: fiscal policy; government spending and taxation policy

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{新|あたら}しい{財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The government announced a new fiscal policy.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}{回復|かいふく}のために{積極的|せっきょくてき}な{財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: An aggressive fiscal policy is needed for economic recovery.

examples.japanese: {財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}と{金融政策|きんゆうせいさく}は、{経済|けいざい}を{安定|あんてい}させるための{二|ふた}つの{柱|はしら}とされている。
examples.english: Fiscal policy and monetary policy are considered the two pillars for stabilizing the economy.

notes:
A compound of {財政|ざいせい} (public finance) + {政策|せいさく} (policy). Refers to government decisions about spending, taxation, and borrowing to influence the economy. A fundamental term in economics and political news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}を{実施|じっし}する: to implement fiscal policy
- {積極的|せっきょくてき}な{財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}: expansionary fiscal policy
- {緊縮|きんしゅく}{財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}: austerity fiscal policy
- {財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}の{転換|てんかん}: shift in fiscal policy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {金融政策|きんゆうせいさく}: monetary policy (central bank's control of money supply and interest rates — the other major economic policy tool)
- {経済政策|けいざいせいさく}: economic policy (broader term encompassing both fiscal and monetary policy)
- {税制|ぜいせい}: tax system (specifically the structure of taxation, one component of fiscal policy)
